skill:skills/palistor/SKILL.md.head: 69faf7f937bcff5e8cddc364fee31450f98521a0
skill:skills/palistor/SKILL.md.reason: Three behaviors changed for every consumer. (1) A group resolve reads `loading: true` from the read that starts it (from creation with lazy: false), not only while the run is in flight, and reading `loading` alone now starts a lazy resolve: async-resolve.md (Start, loading, the mistake renamed to "Waiting for a resolve that never starts") and proxy-api.md (group `loading`) said the opposite and were rewritten. (2) Where `window` is not defined a store starts nothing until store.start(): added to async-resolve.md and to the store table of proxy-api.md. (3) The constructor takes translator / notifier (and initialData / server): integrations.md and proxy-api.md name them; SKILL.md keeps the module-level store as the default and routes a server-rendered screen to palistor-ssr (Setup, routing table, description, version line). The other changed sources carry no guidance change: cube/core/persist.ts only moved its restore walk to cube/core/restore.ts, cube/core/hub.ts added the held / deferred state behind (2), and the cube/react hooks only gained a "use client" directive.
